settings.heading: About Super Shelving
settings.body:
Super Shelving is a Melbourne-based supplier of steel shelving, steel workbenches and MDF shelving, built for garages, workshops and businesses that need more usable space.

We sell direct to the public, cutting out the middleman so you get quality storage at a genuinely competitive price. Every order ships from our own warehouses in Moonee Ponds and Doveton, with same-day local pickup available and delivery Victoria wide.

Our steel shelving uses a tool-free, boltless rivet design, so most units go together solo in under 30 minutes - and every unit is backed by a full 12 month warranty against manufacturing defects.

settings.heading: Victoria Wide Delivery
settings.text: Cheap & fast delivery to anywhere in the state.

settings.text: Quality shelving you can count on, year after year.
